<p><strong>Longitude:</strong> <span id="pub-long"></span></p>

<p><strong>Source:</strong> <span id="pub-source"></span></p>

### Publication data

<div class="data-list">

</div>

<script src="scripts.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async function () {
const jsonFile = "./intermediates/final_dat.json"; 
const targetId = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));

if (!targetId) {
setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('error-message', 'block', "No publication ID specified in the URL.");
return;
}

try {
const textFields = [
['pub-title', 'ArticleTitle'],
['pub-country', 'Country'],
['pub-species', 'Tick species'],
['pub-source', 'Source'],
['pub-year-start', 'Collection year start'],
['pub-year-end', 'Collection year end'],
['pub-exact-location', 'Exact location'],
['pub-year', 'Publication year'],
['pub-id', 'ID']
];

await Promise.all([
...textFields.map(([id, prop]) => updateElementWithData(jsonFile, id, prop)),
updateElementWithDataAndLink(jsonFile, 'pub-city', 'City', 'LID', 'city.html?'),
updateElementWithDataAndLink(jsonFile, 'pub-doi', 'DOI', 'DOI', 'publication.html?'),
updateElementWithDataAndLink(jsonFile, 'pub-site', 'Collection site', ['lat', 'long'], 'map.html?lat=', '&lng=')
]);

const latValue = await getResultValue(jsonFile, 'lat');
const longValue = await getResultValue(jsonFile, 'long');

const formatCoord = (val) => {
if (!val || val === "ID or property not found" || isNaN(val)) return "Not available";
return parseFloat(val).toFixed(4);
};

const latEl = document.getElementById('pub-lat');
const longEl = document.getElementById('pub-long');
if (latEl) latEl.textContent = formatCoord(latValue);
if (longEl) longEl.textContent = formatCoord(longValue);

setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('publication-card', 'block');

} catch (error) {
console.error(error);
setDisplay('loading', 'none');
setDisplay('error-message', 'block', "Error populating data on the page.");
}
});
</script>
